title: Product Update - May 2026
summary: May product update: Marketplace updates, meet recruiter Ashley, Wellfound integration, careers page customization, and custom candidate ratings.
body_markdown:
No two companies hire the same way. That’s why May was all about giving you more control over how you attract, evaluate, and hire talent.


## Marketplace


Dover’s Marketplace gives you flexible access to experienced recruiters and startup experts without the cost of a full-time hire.


Browse experts, schedule intro calls, and bring on support as your needs change. Whether you’re hiring, reviewing contracts, managing finances, or scaling customer operations, you can get the expertise you need, when you need it.


## Meet Ashley, a startup recruiter


Meet Ashley, a startup recruiter with 5 years of experience, who has helped companies across **healthtech** , **fintech** , and **cybersecurity** build scalable hiring processes. She has partnered with growing startups on sourcing, screening, and hiring operations.


Over the past year, Ashley made **50+ hires** for a single client while maintaining an average **cost-per-hire** of just **$1,311** . She specializes in helping startups build efficient recruiting systems that scale as they grow.


### [Meet Startup Experts](https://app.dover.com/marketplace/experts?utm_source=product_newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may26)


## Wellfound integration


You can now sync Wellfound roles and candidates directly into Dover ATS.


The integration gives teams access to 10M+ startup-focused candidates, automatically syncs Wellfound applicants into Dover, and makes it easier to manage hiring workflows in one place.


### [Connect to Wellfound](https://app.dover.com/job-boards?clientId=733c3162-cbbd-6558-9866-1d6b8561f8b9&source=ee9f9c20-9465-4856-b40e-cf497d89a52e)


## Customize your careers page


Your careers page should feel like an extension of your company website. You can now **customize colors** , **backgrounds** , and **fonts** to match your brand.


Create a more consistent candidate experience while keeping your hiring team focused on recruiting instead of design work.


### [Customize Careers Page](https://app.dover.com/edit-careers-page?utm_source=product_newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may26)


## Custom candidate ratings


Every company evaluates candidates differently. Now your scorecards can too.


Create custom numeric and text-based rating scales for interview feedback forms. You can even tailor criteria to each role.


### [Create Feedback Ratings](https://app.dover.com/settings/company/feedback-forms?tab=rating-templates&utm_source=product_newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may26)
